\[ \text{Selling Price} = 1.6W - 0.2 \times 1.6W = 1.6W(1 - 0.2) = 1.6W \times 0.8 = 1.28W \]

We need to find out how much more the selling price is compared to the wholesale cost. This is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percentage Increase} = \left( \frac{0.28W}{W} \right) \times 100 = 0.28 \times 100 = 28\% \]

So, the appliance was sold for 28% more than its wholesale cost.
